name: Peter W. Pier
prior_offices: Niobrara County coroner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Peter W. Pier is the Niobrara County coroner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official general election summary lists him with 897 votes.
